opening.argument: The video promotes the Forsage platform in an income-related context while presenting a wallet security warning as an obstacle to joining or upgrading. Its title says, "If anyone is facing this problem while joining then this problem is solved," and the narration connects the issue to participation by stating, "People have this issue of High Risk when we are getting it joined or it upgraded." Rather than directing viewers away from the offer, it proposes enabling the wallet control with the instruction, "Just turn it ON." The screen displays a Critical Risk Alert and High Risk Detected, while the Security Scanner is shown enabled, making the warning something to work around in pursuing the offer.
